question: The province view's window: when it opens and closes, CProvinceView itself, its refresh (VA 0x6DE5F0) whole and in order for every element briefs B and C do not own, the weather strip, every one of those elements' tooltips out of BuildProvinceViewTooltip, and when it refreshes.

addresses.name: CProvinceView::CProvinceView
addresses.comment: **The province view**, 0x1A4 bytes, made once by CInGameIdler::Enter (`new 0x1A4` at 0x65D6B1, stored at CInGameIdler +0x1CC0, then its window and the custom-game `cgm_underground_build` window hidden). `this` on the stack, `ret 4`. Registers itself as the CReloadableInterface of `province_view`'s .gui file (0xA7E210, base vftable 0x15FDB48, the file name at +4 from the type the gui's slot 18 finds), writes CProvinceView's vftable 0x15D3E00, zeroes +0x20 window, +0x24 province, +0x28, and builds eight VCProvinceView::__CButtonObserverGlue (vftable 0x15D3E0C, 0x2C bytes: +0 vftable, +4 owner, +8 the plain-click handler its slot 2 calls, +0x20 the handler its slot 1 calls with the pressed button, +0x24 the right-click handler its slot 9 calls): +0x2C close (slot 1, CProvinceView::OnClose), +0x58 set_cooperation (slot 2, 0x6E3030), +0x84 open_cov_ops (slot 2, 0x6E1B40), +0xC4 the two flags (slot 1, CProvinceView::OnFlagClicked), +0xF0 spawn_partisan (slot 2, 0x6E1450), +0x11C spawn_underground (slot 2, 0x6E1460), +0x148 underground_mission (slot 2 0x6EA380, slot 9 0x6EA490), +0x178 cgm_underground_build (slot 2, 0x6DDCD0); +0xB4 and +0xBC the tag `---` with id 0. Ends with its own slot 0 (CProvinceView::Rebuild). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DD8D0 to the `ret 4` at 0x6DDBC2: `mov esi,[ebp+8]`, the vftable store 0x15D3E00 at 0x6DD966 (findRefs --vftable CProvinceView: this and the destructor are its only two writers), each glue's vftable 0x15D3E0C / owner / handler stores, and `call 0x6E35C0` at 0x6DDBAB. The glue's slots read off its table: slot 1 0x6D3210 calls [ecx+0x20] with an argument, slot 2 0x7478F0 calls [ecx+8], slot 9 0x6D0F30 calls [ecx+0x24]; the size 0x1A4 is Enter's `push 0x1A4` at 0x65D6AC. Shown wrong if another writer of 0x15D3E00 exists that findRefs misses.

addresses.name: CProvinceView::~CProvinceView
addresses.comment: Slot 1 of CProvinceView, the scalar deleting destructor: the destructor body 0x6DDC00 (restores 0x15D3E00, tears down, restores the CReloadableInterface vftable 0x15FDB48 and unregisters through 0xA7E2E0), then free() where bit 0 of the argument is set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DDBD0 to `ret 4` at 0x6DDBEE: `call 0x6DDC00; test byte [ebp+8],1; ... call 0xB95F9B`. vtable.py --holding 0x6DDBD0: CProvinceView slot 1 alone. Shown wrong if the table's slot 1 were not the destructor (the shape is the compiler's scalar deleting destructor).

addresses.name: CProvinceView::Rebuild
addresses.comment: **Slot 0 of CProvinceView: makes the window and wires it** (the CReloadableInterface reload, and the constructor's last act). Hides and destroys an old window (+0x20, its CGuiObject's slots 14 and the window's slot 20) and an old `cgm_underground_build` (+0x174); makes `province_view` through the gui factory 0x1A857D8 with the in-game screen's slot 16; gives it the group 'province_view'; attaches glue +0x2C to `close_button`, +0xC4 to `owner_flag` **and** `occupier_flag`, +0x58 to `set_cooperation`, +0x84 to `open_cov_ops`, and in the child window `underground` +0xF0 to `spawn_partisan`, +0x11C to `spawn_underground`, +0x148 to `underground_mission` and +0x2C to its own `close_button`; makes `cgm_underground_build` through the in-game gui's slot 3 at +0x174, binds +0x178, places it at the province view's position plus its own, gives it the group 'province_view' and hides it (slot 65). Then, where a province is held (+0x24), CProvinceView::Refresh. Answers whether the window was made. Bare `ret` at 0x6E3D8E. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly and decompilation of 0x6E35C0..0x6E3D8E (bare ret, ECX this): the string literals 'province_view', 'close_button', 'owner_flag', 'occupier_flag', 'set_cooperation', 'open_cov_ops', 'underground', 'spawn_partisan', 'spawn_underground', 'underground_mission', 'cgm_underground_build' each followed by the element's observable (+0x48) slot 1 with this+offset, and `call 0x6DE5F0` at 0x6E3D71 under `cmp [esi+0x24],0`. vtable.py --holding: CProvinceView slot 0 alone. Shown wrong if the window slots called first are not hide/destroy (they are read by analogy with CCountryView::Rebuild's).

addresses.name: CProvinceView::Refresh
addresses.comment: **What the province view shows of a province, set once - on showing it (CInGameIdler_OpenProvinceView) and on CProvinceView::Rebuild - and not again until then.** 0x6DE5F0 to `ret 8` at 0x6E143E. +0x24 = province; the building columns made on first use and pointed at it (brief B); group 'province_view'; the window re-shown where shown (a CFixedWindow's Show re-shows every child). **Several selected** (CInGameIdler +0x130C above 1): `day_night`, both flags, `text_espionage`, `text_partisans`, `text_manpower`, `text_leadership`, the four resource texts, `strategic_resource`, `temperature_txt`, `wind_status`, the list `adj`, the box `claims`, `coop_label`, `cooperation_list`, `cooperation_bg` and the window `cov_ops` hidden; `text_title` = PROV_VIEW_MULTI 'Multiple Selected($NUM$)' with NUM the count; then ProvinceView_Update and out. **One**: `day_night` frame 1 at night else 2 (overwritten at once by ProvinceView_Update, which has it the right way round); `text_title` here and in `underground` = the province's name (second table slot 7); +0xB4/+0xBC = owner and controller tags; `owner_flag` = the owner's flag (button slot 53 with the id, then slot 27); `occupier_flag` hidden (and kept at +0x28) where the controller's id is the owner's, else +0x28 = 0 and the controller's flag; `terrain` = a sprite of GFX_terrainimg_plains's shape over gfx/interface/prov_pictures/provimg_<id>.dds where FileExists, otherwise the sprite GFX_terrainimg_ + the terrain's key (template +0xC, slot 7, +0x28), re-shown where the window is shown; `text_espionage` = the player's (state +0xC34) byte of the province's +0x370 as a whole number, 0 past the array; where that byte is under 9 `text_partisans`, `text_manpower` and `text_leadership` are '?', else revolt risk (ProvinceView_RevoltRiskReadout), manpower '-' where the base (+0x320) is 0 else '\xA7Y' + FormatFixedPoint(Province_GetEffectiveManpower, 2), leadership the same with +0x324 and Province_GetEffectiveLeadership; `text_oil`, `text_metal`, `text_energy`, `text_raremat` = ProvinceView_ResourceText for goods 3, 4, 5, 6; `strategic_resource` = 'GFX_' + the resource's key (+0x30) + '_small' set as its sprite where the graphics hold it, shown (slots 66, 13) where the province's resource (+0x18) is a real one (slot 14), hidden (slot 65) for the null one; the list `adj` grown or cut to the template's edge count with a CAdjMember per edge index, each CAdjMember::Update(province); the window shown again where shown and +0x28 hidden again; `claims` emptied and given one `prov_claims_entry` per core (+0x344 list, in its order) with its `flag` icon the core's flag, laid out and shown; `coop_label`, `cooperation_list`, `cooperation_bg`, `cov_ops` hidden; group set again; `cgm_underground_build` hidden; ProvinceView_Update. `overlay`, `overlay2`, `background`, the icons beside the figures, `covert_ops_icon`, `open_cov_ops` and `cov_ops_points` are not touched here. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing whole (0x6DE5F0..0x6E143E, ret 8, two callers 0x673663 and 0x6E3D71 each pushing province then view), every element by its pushed literal and the window lookup slot that follows (0x34 button, 0x3C instant text, 0x44 icon, 0x6C child window, 0x7C list box, 0x9C overlapping box) and the element slot after it (0x38 hide, 0x48 frame, 0xE0/0xE4 sprite, 0xD4 flag); `cmp [eax+0x130C],1; jle` at 0x6DEA87; `cmp eax,9; jge 0x6E0370` at 0x6E011F; `cmp [ecx+0x320]` 0x6E053D and `cmp [ecx+0x324]` 0x6E0712; `cmp eax,[edi+0xB8]` 0x6DF9C1 for the occupier. Literals checked: 0x15B4EB8 '?', 0x15C49C4 '-', 0x15B5C54 '\xA7Y', 0x15D3948 'gfx/interface/prov_pictures/provimg_'. Shown wrong if any of the window slots above is misidentified (they are those FINDINGS-unitpanel.md and FINDINGS-guilive.md give).

addresses.name: ProvinceView_ResourceText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __stdcall ProvinceView_ResourceText(CProvinceView* view@stack:4, int goods@stack:8, Hoi3CString* out@EDI) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The text of `text_oil` / `text_metal` / `text_energy` / `text_raremat`** for goods 3, 4, 5, 6. Where the province's max_producing of the good (+0x294 + 4g) is 0 or less: '\xA7W0'. Else where the player's byte of the province (+0x370, id from state +0xC34; none past the array) is under 9: '\xA7Y?\xA7W'. Else '\xA7R' where current_producing (+0x270 + 4g) is below max_producing, '\xA7G' otherwise, then CMapProvince::ResourceYield(province, goods) / 1000 as a float through FormatFloat with 1 place - **rounded**, unlike FormatFixedPoint - and no closing colour. `ret 8`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DE400 to `ret 8` at 0x6DE5E6: `cmp [eax+edx*4+0x294],ebx; jg`, the intel compare `cmp eax,9; jge`, `cmp [eax+edx*4+0x270],ecx; jge`, the literals 0x15D37E4 '\xA7W0', 0x15D37E8 '\xA7Y?\xA7W', 0x15B5C58 '\xA7R', 0x15B5C50 '\xA7G', the call 0x4A6EB0 and `push 1` before FormatFloat 0xA5AEC0; out in EDI, written through and returned. Four callers, the refresh's pushes 3, 4, 5, 6. Shown wrong if +0x270/+0x294 are not current/max_producing with an 8-byte pool header (CGoodsPool at +0x268/+0x28C).

addresses.name: CProvinceView::OnClose
addresses.comment: **`close_button`, in the view and in its `underground` window: CInGameIdler::ClearSelection** (slot 46) on the in-game screen - the view closes because nothing is selected any more, not by hiding it. Glue +0x2C's slot-1 handler. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DE340 to `ret 4` at 0x6DE3F1: the game-state singleton, `mov ecx,[esi+0xBE8]; call [vft+0xB8]` - slot 46 of CInGameIdler (0x656CD0, recorded as ClearSelection). Bound by CProvinceView::Rebuild to both close buttons. Shown wrong if the in-game screen at +0xBE8 were not CInGameIdler at the time (it is in a running game).

addresses.name: CProvinceView::OnFlagClicked
addresses.comment: **A click on `owner_flag` or `occupier_flag`.** Nothing in a custom game's setup (GetCustomGameSettings' byte). `owner_flag`: where no scenario is loaded (state +0xD0C null), CInGameIdler::OpenCountryView(0) - the diplomacy screen. Otherwise (the occupier's flag): the country of the button's flag id (button slot 32), CInGameIdler::ClearSelection, CInGameIdler::Select of that country's capital province (CCountry::GetCapitalLocation, its selectable at +8) - which opens the view on the capital - then the same OpenCountryView(0) where no scenario is loaded. Glue +0xC4's slot-1 handler. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6EA010 to `ret 4` at 0x6EA37A: `call 0x41C4E0; cmp al,bl; jne` exit; window slot 13 ('owner_flag') compared with [ebp+8] and `je 0x6EA2D9`; the button's slot 32, countries [state+0xBBC] and +0xCA4/+0xCA8; slot 46 (+0xB8), `call 0x417AF0`, `lea edi,[eax+8]`, slot 38 (+0x98, 0x656D10); `cmp [eax+0xD0C],ebx; jne` then `push 0; call 0x6656D0`. Shown wrong if button slot 32 is not the flag's country (it returns the sprite's slot 85, the counterpart of the slot 83 that slot 53 sets).

addresses.name: CAdjMember::CAdjMember
addresses.comment: **One row of the province view's `adj` list**, 0x34 bytes (the refresh's `new 0x34`): the window `adj_member` through the in-game screen's gui at +0x20, the list-item vftables 0x15D3EF8 / 0x15D3F2C (+0x1C), +0x28 province = 0, +0x2C neighbour id = 0, +0x30 = the edge's index in the province template's edge vector. `ret 8`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DCBF0 to `ret 8` at 0x6DCD33: 'adj_member' 0x15D372C, the stores at +0x20/+0x28/+0x2C/+0x30 and the two vftables (RTTI CAdjMember 0x15D3EF8). One caller, the refresh at 0x6E0FB6, pushing the running index. Shown wrong if the refresh's index were not an edge index (it counts to (template+0x94 - template+0x90)/0x14).

addresses.name: CAdjMember::Update
addresses.comment: **What an `adj` row says.** +0x28 = province; edge = the template's edge +0x30 (+0x90, 0x14 bytes each); +0x2C = its neighbour's id; `adj_text` = the neighbour's name (second table slot 7). `adj_icon`'s sprite (icon slot 57) by the edge's kind: 1 GFX_provinceview_strait, 2 GFX_provinceview_river, 3 GFX_provinceview_impassable; any other (0) GFX_provinceview_ocean where the neighbour is sea (template +0x22 clear), else GFX_provinceview_passable. `ret 4`. Not in any vftable. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DCD40 to `ret 4` at 0x6DD0CC: `lea eax,[eax+eax*4]` x4 on +0x30 into template+0x90, `cmp eax,1/2/3` at 0x6DCED4/0x6DCF19/0x6DCF5B with the three literals, `cmp byte [eax+0x22],bl` at 0x6DD00F for ocean/passable, slot 0xE4 on 'adj_icon', slot 0x3C 'adj_text' +0xD0. ProvinceEdge +0 kind and +4 to_province are recorded. Shown wrong if kind 1 meant something other than a crossing (the record: `sea` in adjacencies.csv).

addresses.name: CAdjMember_GetNeighbourTemplate
addresses.comment: The template (+0xD4) of an `adj` row's neighbour, the province state +0xB8C indexes by the row's +0x2C. Asked by BuildProvinceViewTooltip for a plain edge, to tell PV_OCEAN from PV_PASSABLE. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6DD0D0 to `ret 4` at 0x6DD17F: the singleton, `mov ecx,[eax+0x2C]; mov edx,[esi+0xB8C]; mov eax,[edx+ecx*4]; mov eax,[eax+0xD4]`. Its one caller found is 0x6E728E (findRefs --callers reports none, the call being read off BuildProvinceViewTooltip's listing). Shown wrong if +0x2C were not the neighbour id CAdjMember::Update writes.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ShowProvinceViewById
addresses.comment: Slot 10: the province state +0xB8C holds at the id, handed to its own slot 11 (ShowProvinceView). `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6631C0 to `ret 4` at 0x663279: `mov ecx,[esi+0xB8C]; mov ecx,[ecx+edx*4]; call [vft+0x2C]`. vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 10 alone. Callers not found (through the table only).

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ShowProvinceView
addresses.comment: **Slot 11: show the province view for a province** - nothing for a null province, province id 0, or one whose template is not `simulated` (+0x13D); otherwise CInGameIdler_OpenProvinceView. Called by CProvince::OnSelected (through the province's selection listener, +0xCC), slot 10 and slot 13. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x6632E0 to `ret 4` at 0x66330D: `cmp [eax+0xD0],0; je`, `cmp byte [edx+0x13D],0; je`, `mov edi,ecx; call 0x673630`. vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 11 alone.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::HideProvinceView
addresses.comment: Slot 12: hides the province view's window (+0x1CC0's +0x20, its CGuiObject's slot 14) and tail-jumps to the `cgm_underground_build` window's slot 65 (hide). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x663310..0x663334 (`jmp edx`, a tail call to [+0x174]'s slot 65): `mov esi,[ecx+0x1CC0]`, `[ecx+0x18]` slot 14, `[esi+0x174]` slot 0x104. vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 12 alone. Shown wrong if CGuiObject slot 14 were not Hide (FINDINGS-guilive.md section 5 reads it so).

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::RefreshProvinceViewFromSelection
addresses.comment: **Slot 13: make the view follow the selection.** With nothing selected (+0x130C 0): slot 12 (HideProvinceView), twice. Otherwise the first thing in the selection, in the order it was selected, whose slot 1 answers 3 (a province) gets slot 11 (ShowProvinceView); none: slot 12. Called by CProvince::OnDeselected. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x663280..0x6632D9: `cmp [ebx+0x130C],0; jne`, `call [vft+0x30]` then `jmp [vft+0x30]`; the walk from +0x1304 with `call [vft+4]; cmp eax,3; je`, `lea eax,[edi-8]; call [vft+0x2C]`. vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 13 alone.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::GetProvinceView
addresses.comment: Slot 82: `mov eax,[ecx+0x1CC0]; ret` - the province view. What CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip hands BuildProvinceViewTooltip. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Two instructions read whole. vtable.py --holding 0x662C40: CInGameIdler slot 82 alone; luabind.json has no registration at that address (trap 4's second half). Called at 0x6C606E, its result pushed as BuildProvinceViewTooltip's first argument.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::Select
addresses.comment: Slot 38: CSelectable_Select(selectable, the selection +0x1304) - appended, marked and told (its slot 4) - and selection_changed (+0x1D3C) = 1 where it is an air unit (slot 1 answers 2). It does not clear the selection first. Used by CProvinceView::OnFlagClicked to select the occupier's capital. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x656D10 to `ret 4` at 0x656D43: `lea esi,[ebx+0x1304]; call 0x4AD620`, `call [vft+4]; cmp eax,2; jne`, `mov byte [ebx+0x1D3C],1`. vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 38 alone.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_OpenProvinceView
addresses.comment: **The view comes up**: its window shown (CGuiObject slot 13, which re-shows every child), the element kept at view +0x28 hidden again, CProvinceView::Refresh(view, province), the icon `bg_main_menus` (+0x1914) hidden, and the byte +0x1D3D = 1. Its one caller is CInGameIdler::ShowProvinceView. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x673630 to `ret 4` at 0x67367E: `mov esi,[edi+0x1CC0]`, [+0x20]+0x18 slot 13, `cmp [esi+0x28],0` then its slot 14, `push eax(province); push ecx(view); call 0x6DE5F0`, `[edi+0x1914]` slot 14, `mov byte [edi+0x1D3D],1`. findRefs --callers: 0x663306 only. +0x1914 is the icon 'bg_main_menus' made in CInGameIdler::Enter at 0x65F89E.

addresses.name: CProvince::OnSelected
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of the province's second table (the CSelectable at +8; CMapProvince keeps it), what CSelectable_Select calls. **A land province with a selection listener (+0xCC) tells it - the in-game screen's slot 11, ShowProvinceView; a sea zone, or no listener, clears the whole selection** (CInGameIdler::ClearSelection), the sea zone with it. Then the sound 'click' where it is not already playing, and the province's id onto the in-game screen's list of provinces to repaint (+0x88, flag +0x84 |= 0x200; 0x6434C0, or 0x679590 for -1). `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x49E240 to `ret 4` at 0x49E4B9/0x49E4E6 (this = province + 8): `cmp [eax+0xC4],ebx; je` and `cmp byte [ecx+0x22],bl; je` (template +0x22 through this+0xCC), `call [vft+0x2C]` with eax-8 pushed, else `[esi+0xBE8]` slot 0xB8; the literal 'click' and the sound object's slots 25/9; `or dword [eax+0x84],0x200`. vtable.py --holding: CProvince and CMapProvince slot 4 at object offset 8. Shown wrong if +0xCC held something other than the screen (CMap_SetSelectionListener writes it).

addresses.name: CProvince::OnDeselected
addresses.comment: Slot 5 of the province's second table: the province's id onto the repaint list (as OnSelected), then, where a selection listener is set (+0xCC), its slot 13 - CInGameIdler::RefreshProvinceViewFromSelection - so the view moves to the first province still selected, or closes. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x49E4F0 to the bare `ret` at 0x49E5FC: `mov edi,[ecx+0xC8]` (the id), `or [eax+0x84],0x200`, `cmp [param+0xC4],0` then `call [vft+0x34]`. vtable.py --holding: CProvince and CMapProvince slot 5 at object offset 8. Called with no argument by Selection_Remove and Selection_Clear.

addresses.name: CMap_SetSelectionListener
addresses.comment: Stores the listener at CMap +0x2A68 and in every province's +0xCC (the vector +0x2200..+0x2204). Called by CInGameIdler's constructor with the idler (0x649028) - which is how a click on a province reaches the in-game screen - and by CEU3Application::MakeBackEndIdler (0x6088B1), CFrontEnd::CFrontEnd (0x6EDACE) and 0x69D703 (a screen whose constructor was not identified), each with its own screen. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4920B0 to the bare `ret` at 0x4920F4: `mov [eax+0x2A68],edx`, the loop over [eax+0x2200] with `mov [esi+0xCC],edx`. findRefs --callers: four, each `mov eax,[0x1A8557C]` (g_CMap) and `mov edx,ebx` before the call; at 0x649026 ebx is CInGameIdler::CInGameIdler's this. The province constructor zeroes +0xCC (0x494821).

addresses.name: Selection_Remove
addresses.no_signature: Register convention ending in a tail call: the selection list in EAX, the selectable in EDI; unlinks its node, clears its +4 and jumps to its slot 5 (OnDeselected), whose own `ret` returns.
addresses.comment: Takes one thing out of a selection list: its node unlinked (0x5D49D0), its selected byte (+4) cleared, then its slot 5 (OnDeselected). What a shift-click on something already selected does. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4AD680..0x4AD6AE (`jmp edx` to [vft+0x14]): the walk `cmp [eax],edi`, `call 0x5D49D0`, `mov byte [edi+4],0`. findRefs --callers: 0x6532F7 only, in CInGameIdler_HandleInput's shift-click arm after CList_Contains.

addresses.name: Selection_CanAdd
addresses.comment: Whether a thing may join a selection: not already selected (+4), its slot 2 answers true, and where the selection is not empty its slot 1 (the kind - 0 army, 1 fleet, 2 air, 3 province) equals the first selected thing's. **So a selection is all of one kind: provinces join only provinces.** Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4AD6B0..0x4AD6ED: `cmp byte [esi+4],0`, `call [vft+8]`, `cmp [edi+8],0`, the two `call [vft+4]` and `cmp eax,edi`. The province's slot 2 is ReturnTrue (0xA92590) in both province tables.

addresses.name: Selection_Clear
addresses.comment: Empties a selection list: the list is detached first, then each thing in it in order gets its +4 cleared and its slot 5 (OnDeselected) - so every province's OnDeselected already sees an empty selection and closes the view - and the nodes are freed. What CInGameIdler::ClearSelection and the plain click run. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4AD6F0 to `ret 4` at 0x4AD7D2: the head/tail/count of [ebp+8] copied out and zeroed before the loop, `mov byte [esi+4],bl; call [vft+0x14]`, the free loop. findRefs --callers: nine, among them CInGameIdler::ClearSelection (0x656CE8) and the plain-click arm of CInGameIdler_HandleInput (0x6533A2) and its drag-box arm (0x652E14).

addresses.name: Province_GetEffectiveManpower
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __cdecl Province_GetEffectiveManpower(CMapProvince* province@EAX, CFixedPoint* out@EDI, int unused@stack:4) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The manpower the province view shows**: (manpower (+0x320) + MANPOWER (modifier 3) of the province) x max(0, 1000 + LOCAL_MANPOWER (5) of the province + GLOBAL_MANPOWER (6) of the owner's country) / 1000, 64-bit and truncated, then not below 0. The one stack word (the refresh pushes the base) is never read. Bare `ret`; one caller, CProvinceView::Refresh. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4A5140 to `ret` at 0x4A519D: `[edx+0x18]` (id 3 x 8), `[edx+0x28]` (id 5), `add esi,0x3E8`, `lea ecx,[eax+0x32C]; call 0x402610` (CCountryTag::GetCountry), `[eax+0xDA8]` +0x30 (id 6), `jns` floor, `imul` and `__alldiv` by 1000, `jns` floor. Ids named from modifierIds.json. findRefs --callers: 0x6E0612 only.

addresses.name: Province_GetEffectiveLeadership
addresses.comment: **The leadership the province view shows**: (leadership (+0x324) + MODIFIER_LOCAL_LEADERSHIP (32) of the province) x max(0, 1000 + MODIFIER_LOCAL_LEADERSHIP_MODIFIER (34) of the province) / 1000, 64-bit and truncated, then not below 0. No country term. Bare `ret`; one caller, CProvinceView::Refresh. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole, 0x4A5310 to `ret` at 0x4A5352: `[ecx+0x324]`, values +0x100 (id 32) and +0x110 (id 34), `add ecx,0x3E8; jns`, `imul`, `__alldiv` 1000, `jns` floor. findRefs --callers: 0x6E07D3 only.

addresses.name: IntelLevelText
addresses.comment: **What an intelligence level is called**: a jump table over 0..9 - INTEL_NONE 'No intel (0)', INTEL_STRUCTURES 'Basic Intel (1)', INTEL_UNITS 'Basic Intel, divisions of unknown strength (2)', INTEL_2 'Intel lvl 3' .. INTEL_7 'Intel lvl 8' (the key's number one below the level's), MAX_INTEL_LEVEL 'Full Intel (9)' - rendered; above 9 the empty string. The tooltip of the province view's `espionage` and `text_espionage`, and of the map tooltip (0x49AFA7). `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole: `cmp eax,9; ja 0x4A7D16` (the empty-string arm, literal 0x15B4945), `jmp [eax*4+0x4A7D44]` with the ten targets read off the table, each loading one key literal (0x15BEB10..0x15BEB6C) into GetText and Render with out in EDI; each arm `ret 4`. findRefs --callers: 0x49AFA7 and 0x6E78F3. English from localisation/*.csv.

addresses.name: BuildProvinceViewTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall BuildProvinceViewTooltip(CProvinceView* view, GuiTooltipText* out, void* element) @EAX
addresses.comment:
**The tooltip of every element whose group is 'province_view'** (CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip at 0x6C6047: the element's group compared with 'province_view', then this with CInGameIdler::GetProvinceView). Dispatches on the element's name (its slot 17) and fills a local GuiTooltipText - `text`, and `delayed` where noted - copied into `out`, which it returns. Body 0x2E4250..0x2E7BFF, `ret 0xC` (trap 2: the `ret 4` at 0x2E9157 is the next function's). In order: in a custom game's setup the `cgm_underground_build` window itself: CGM_TOOLTIP_UNDERGROUND_BUILD_DESTROY + delayed 0x6E3D90(underground building); `terrain`: the terrain's localised name (CTerrain slot 6) + delayed CTerrain_BuildFigures; `oil`/`metal`/`energy`/`rare`: GoodName 3/4/5/6; `text_oil`/`text_metal`/`text_energy`/`text_raremat`: BASE + ' \xA7Y' + current_producing to 2 places + '\xA7W
', for metal/energy/rare where the controller's technology factor (CTechnologyStatus +0xAC/+0xB4/+0xB0) is not 0 FROM_TECHNOLOGY + ': \xA7G+' + factor x 100 to 2 places + '%\xA7W
', then the contributors to LOCAL_<good> and to LOCAL_RESOURCES in the province's modifier, '
', and the contributors to GLOBAL_<good> and to GLOBAL_RESOURCES in the controller's (CModifier::DescribeContributors, scale 1000, each appended as it comes) - no intelligence gate; `strategic_resource`: the resource's key localised + delayed its every value (CModifier::DescribeAllValues); `weather_icon`: WEATHER_SNOW_STORM / _SNOW / _STORM / _RAIN / _CLOUD / _PARTIAL_CLOUD by CWeather::GraphicName, else WEATHER_CLEAR_SKY; `ground_status_icon`: WEATHER_FROZEN where frozen > 0, else WEATHER_MUDDY where muddyness > 0, else WEATHER_DRY; `wind_status` and `wind_icon`: WEATHER_WIND with SPEED = windspeed to 1 place; `temperature_txt`: WEATHER_TEMPERATURE; `owner_flag` PV_OWNER, `flag` PV_HAS_CLAIM, `occupier_flag` PV_OCC, each NAME = the country of the element's own flag id (slot 32); `espionage`/`text_espionage`: IntelLevelText of the player's byte (0 past the array); `icon_manpower`/`text_manpower` PV_MANPOWER; `icon_leadership`/`text_leadership` PV_LEADERSHIP; `partisans_icon` PV_RR; `text_partisans` BuildProvinceRevoltRiskTooltip; `adj_icon`/`adj_text`: the `adj` row owning the element (its +0x1C table's slot 22) - kind 0 PV_PASSABLE + delayed PV_PASSABLE_DESC or, the neighbour at sea, PV_OCEAN + PV_OCEAN_DESC; kind 2 PV_RIVER + PV_RIVER_DESC; kind 1 PV_STRAIT + PV_STRAIT_DESC; kind 3 nothing; then the building and underground elements (brief B). Last, whatever matched: where `cov_ops`'s `cov_ops_bg` is shown, an entry of `cov_ops_list` that owns the element answers instead (0x6E2230, brief C). No tooltip for `text_title`, `close_button`, `day_night`, `overlay`, `overlay2`, `background`, `covert_ops_icon`, `open_cov_ops`, `cov_ops_points`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.4.
addresses.revises: The signature had the arguments in the wrong order and untyped: `[ebp+8]` is the view (EDI; its +0x24 province, +0x20 window and +0x174 are read), `[ebp+0xC]` the out GuiTooltipText (copy-constructed into at 0x6E7BAC and returned in EAX) and `[ebp+0x10]` the element (ESI; its slot 17 gives the name compared). The caller 0x6C6057..0x6C6071 pushes the element, then the out, then CInGameIdler slot 82's answer. The comment now says which element answers what, where it only listed keys.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing whole (0x6E4250..0x6E7BFD): `mov edi,[ebp+8]` / `mov esi,[ebp+0x10]` at the prologue and `mov eax,[ebp+0xC]` before each `ret 0xC`; each name literal compared through 0x40C3C0 against the element's slot 17; the key literals listed; DescribeContributors called through the modifier's slot 9 with ids 0x12/0x55/0x13/0x54 (oil), 0x16/0x55/0x17/0x54 (metal), 0x14/0x55/0x15/0x54 (energy), 0x18/0x55/0x19/0x54 (rare); the tech offsets +0xAC/+0xB4/+0xB0 off CCountry +0xDF8. Shown wrong if GuiTooltipText +0x1C were not the delayed half (the record's struct says it is).

addresses.name: ProvinceView_RevoltRiskReadout
addresses.comment: **What the province view shows as revolt risk** (`text_partisans`, in CProvinceView::Refresh, 0x6DE5F0). Only where the player (+0xC34) knows the province at 9 (`intel_by_country_ptr (+0x370)`, `cmp eax,9; jge` at 0x6E011F): r = max(GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk, max(values[0], 0)); the text is '\xA7Y' when r > 0 (nothing otherwise) + FormatFixedPoint(r, 1) + '%'; below 9 the three figures `text_partisans`, `text_manpower` and `text_leadership` all read '?'. Its icon `partisans_icon` has the tooltip PV_RR ('Revolt Risk'), and the figure the breakdown BuildProvinceRevoltRiskTooltip (BuildProvinceViewTooltip, 0x6E66D6..0x6E678D). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-occupation.md, section B.6, and FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section A.3.
addresses.revises: The comment called the refresh 'a function at 0x6DE5F0 not otherwise recorded'; it is now recorded as CProvinceView::Refresh. Nothing else changes.
addresses.evidence: The refresh at 0x6DE5F0 is this fragment's CProvinceView::Refresh; the label lies inside it (0x6DE5F0..0x6E143E).

struct_fields.name: selection_listener
struct_fields.comment: Who a selection of this province is told to: CProvince::OnSelected calls its slot 11 (CInGameIdler::ShowProvinceView) and OnDeselected its slot 13. Written for every province by CMap_SetSelectionListener (the in-game screen's constructor hands it the idler); the province constructor zeroes it. The field is the base's, CProvince +0xCC.
struct_fields.evidence: CMap_SetSelectionListener's loop `mov [esi+0xCC],edx`; OnSelected reads this(+8)+0xC4; the constructor `mov [esi+0xCC],ebx` at 0x494821. Typed void*: the setter is also called by CEU3Application::MakeBackEndIdler (0x6088B1), CFrontEnd::CFrontEnd (0x6EDACE) and 0x69D703, each with its own screen in EDX.
